notices.title: Cookie Policy
notices.description: Storage and preference choices in Artanrecords Studio.

sections.title: Essential storage
paragraphs: Consent choices and account security use necessary browser storage. Essential storage is always active. Studio uses session storage to keep your sign-in within this browser tab; account access does not require consent to optional preference memory.

sections.title: Optional preferences
paragraphs: With preference memory allowed, this browser remembers appearance, contrast, palette and workspace sidebar choices across visits. Declining optional storage keeps changes in session storage until the tab session ends. These choices do not currently synchronize to an artist account.

sections.title: Analytics
paragraphs: Analytics are not connected. Choosing an analytics preference does not activate tracking or create listening or royalty reports. Any future analytics service must be disclosed here before activation.

sections.title: Change your choices
paragraphs: Open Cookies & preferences from the footer or Privacy settings to save individual choices, allow optional categories or decline them. Withdrawing preference memory removes persistent Studio appearance and navigation settings from this browser; essential consent and security records remain separate.

notices.title: Privacy and cookies
notices.description: How Artanrecords Studio handles account information and your choices.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: Studio and Artan Store use a shared Supabase account identity, including your email, password or Google sign-in and verification status. You can use the same credentials for both services. A password change affects this shared identity; signing out of Studio ends its session without deliberately signing out your other devices or Store sessions. Studio profile information, private profile photographs and billing addresses are stored separately from Store purchase records and are restricted to your account. Creating an account is not artist approval and does not grant access to another artist's work or financial records.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: Essential browser storage supports security and your consent choices. Optional preference memory stores appearance, contrast, palette and sidebar choices across visits only when permitted. Declining optional storage keeps interface changes in session storage until the tab session ends. Analytics are not connected. These preferences do not currently synchronize to an artist account. See the Cookie Policy for storage categories and controls.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: For access, correction, deletion or privacy questions, contact contact@artanrecords.com. Identify whether your request concerns your Studio profile or the shared Store and Studio identity. Deleting that shared identity can affect access to both services; requests require review before action. Some records may need to be retained to meet contractual or legal obligations. Studio payments and payouts are not active; no banking or tax information should be submitted through profile or public enquiry fields.

notices.title: Studio terms
notices.description: Access to Artanrecords Studio and artist services.

sections.title: Accounts and artist access
paragraphs: Use accurate account information and protect your credentials. Studio uses the same account identity as Artan Store; password changes and shared-identity deletion affect access to both services. Your Studio artist profile is separate from Store purchases. Creating an account is separate from an artist agreement and does not confer artist approval, a release deal or access to another person's records. Payments, payouts and contract signing remain unavailable until separately activated and disclosed.

sections.title: Your work
paragraphs: Submit only material you are entitled to share. A submission is not an agreement to release or distribute a recording. Distribution, rights, royalty splits and payment obligations require a separate confirmed agreement.

sections.title: Royalties and payments
paragraphs: Listening statistics are not a royalty statement. Earnings, deductions, currencies, reporting periods and payout eligibility depend on verified reports and the applicable agreement. No payout amount or date is promised by an unconnected workspace. Payment or identity onboarding must use the designated secure provider; do not send bank details through public enquiries.

sections.title: Help and statutory rights
paragraphs: Contact contact@artanrecords.com for access or service questions. These terms do not remove rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. Financial services, charges and payment-provider terms must be disclosed before those features are activated.

sections.title: Workspace preferences
paragraphs: Appearance and workspace controls personalize this browser and do not alter an artist agreement, royalty calculation or service entitlement. Optional storage follows your cookie choices. Account preference synchronization and custom background rendering are not connected; no service is activated by selecting a prepared control.
